premises.text: Improving sport technique requires measuring small distances and multi-point motion that consumer GPS wearables cannot resolve
premises.evidence_span: GPS is not precise enough. GPS has got an inaccuracy of 15 feet, if you're lucky

premises.text: QOSP devices on multiple body points stream strength, angle, acceleration, and inch-accurate position in real time
premises.evidence_span: You can see the angle with which we hit the ball. You can see the strength with which we hit the ball. And you can see also our maximum acceleration on the field

premises.text: Core positioning analyzes satellite signals with differential GNSS via devices plus an access point
premises.evidence_span: Signals are received by the QOSP devices and the QOSP access point, which fuses the motion readings and corrects the satellite signal using the technique called differential GNSS positioning

premises.text: Platform APIs support gaming, drones, and animation, while go-to-market focuses on team sports lacking tactic/injury/scouting tools
premises.evidence_span: we are going to keep a razor sharp focus on the team sport market
